changelog: Dropbear SSH Server Auto-Startup: Built-in automatic Dropbear daemon launcher on system boot across appliance, ISO, and hard disk installs (port 22, root login enabled)
Alpine Linux ZeroTier Engine: Offline package embedding in ISO build and smart runtime auto-installer for Alpine environments
ZeroTier Background Daemon Detachment: Non-blocking daemon management preventing pipe deadlocks and web worker freezes
Enhanced VPN Telemetry Sync: Real-time network state sync triggering even before initial config save
Fix ZeroTier network join not sending join request (auto-enable daemon, await control socket readiness)
Fix config wipe on general Save: VPN networks, WireGuard peers/keys, stealth, auth, and license settings now preserved
ZeroTier Network ID input sanitization (strips non-hex, enforces 16 chars) in both UI and server
Auto-install ZeroTier daemon if missing on host system
JSON-based ZeroTier network status sync via zerotier-cli -j listnetworks for richer telemetry
WireGuard VPN Engine (🔐): Full embedded kernel WireGuard server & peer manager with port 51820 UDP and configurable subnets
WireGuard Auto-Keypair & QR Generator (📱): 1-click automatic cryptographic keypair generation with instant scannable QR Code and .conf download for iOS & Android
WireGuard Peer Real-Time Telemetry: Live handshake tracking (last seen), real-time RX/TX bandwidth, endpoint IP, and allowed IPs
ZeroTier SDN Cloud Mesh (🌐): Full embedded ZeroTier service integration with 10-hex Node ID, network joiner, and multi-network controller
ZeroTier Dynamic Status & IP Tracking: Real-time network status monitoring (OK, ACCESS_DENIED, REQUESTING) and virtual IP address discovery
Remote Web Dashboard & SSH Access: Automated iptables firewall bypass rules allowing full remote management through WireGuard (10.250.0.1:8080) and ZeroTier virtual IPs from anywhere worldwide
Interactive Subscriber Edit (✏️): Full modal to modify subscriber username, password, profile, static IP, notes, enabled state, and expiry
Interactive Speed Profile Edit (✏️): Full modal to modify profile name, download/upload bandwidth limits, validity duration, and description
Dynamic Profile Cascading: Renaming a speed profile automatically cascades to all associated active subscribers
Live Active Session Hot-Reload: Editing subscriber credentials or assigned speed profile dynamically reconnects active ppp sessions with new limits
Expiry Preservation Mode: Flexible toggle to preserve existing expiration date or calculate new validity upon editing subscriber
Fix broadband status 16KB JSON truncation (expanded to 4MB streaming buffer) resolving empty subscriber table
Fix broadband sessions 32KB JSON truncation (expanded to 2MB streaming buffer)
Protect subscriber and profile database against accidental wipe during generic /api/v1/apply calls
Fix speed profile reset on replace mode so old preset profiles are cleanly replaced by imported profiles
Enhanced SAS4 API deep sync to fetch cleartext passwords and real profile names via /user/overview/{id}
Enhanced spreadsheet parsing supporting ct_password, profile_name, and expiration dates from SASMAN/SAS4 Excel exports
Fix Alpine expression error for wan.scannedNetworks during initial dashboard rendering
SASMAN Migration Engine: Full Excel (.xlsx, .xls) and CSV subscriber import & export with interactive preview table
Direct SAS4 Billing System API Sync with official OpenSSL AES-256-CBC decryptor and multi-page user extraction
Automatic speed profile recognition, auto-creation with bandwidth limits, and expiration date conversion (Excel serial / ISO)
Increased subscriber database capacity to 4,096 PPPoE accounts and 64 speed profiles
Export subscribers directly to Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) and SASMAN/MikroTik-compatible CSV templates
CORS Preflight HTTP OPTIONS support for frictionless cross-origin API integration
Full RadSec Protocol Support (RFC 6614 — RADIUS over TLS on TCP port 2083) with mTLS encryption
Standard RADIUS AAA Client (RFC 2865 / 2866) with CoA / Disconnect support (RFC 3576)
Carrier Stealth Shield: Outgoing IPv4 TTL Normalization (Anti-Tethering & Single-Hop Masking)
Traceroute Cloaking (suppresses ICMP Type 11 Time Exceeded leakage) and WAN Port Scan Blackhole
Dynamic subscriber rate limiting via MikroTik-Rate-Limit (VSA 14988) and WISPr dictionary attributes
Glassmorphism Web Dashboard interactive cards for RADIUS / RadSec AAA and Carrier Stealth Shield
Fix ICMP ping prober latency calculation for dynamic DHCP interfaces (resolved 0 ms RTT issue)
Automatic probe target fallback to gateway IP or 8.8.8.8 for all WAN types
Stealth MAC Cloaking: Authentic TP-Link, Tenda, and D-Link OUIs with non-sequential random MACs
UDHCPC Option 60 cloaked as TP-Link Archer C6 replacing BusyBox signatures
Uncrackable Ed25519 asymmetric cryptographic licensing engine (RFC 8032)
Hardware fingerprint binding (HWID) anti-cloning and anti-theft protection
Anti-clock rollback monotonic watermark ledger preventing NTP/time tampering
